correctness.rationale: The canonical least-point exhaustive search visits 1690154 states and exactly 73920 point-labelled (9_3) incidence structures; its triangle strata contain 3360, 30240 and 40320 structures. Point automorphism orders 108, 12, 9 yield those same orbit sizes, proving exactly one class per stratum. Exact 17x17 reduced Laplacians from the three explicit incidence lists have computed Smith factors (2,6,6,18,18,54), (2,6,48,2160), and (214,5778). Separate exact Bareiss determinants equal the factor products, 1259712, 1244160, and 1236492, verifying the matrix-tree counts. Full source code and inputs are supplied and executed.

value.rationale: The (9_3) configurations form the first natural small case of three combinatorial point-line types. Determining both previously unlisted non-Pappus full critical groups, not only tree counts, completes a natural classification and reveals three disjoint prime-support patterns: only 2,3 for Pappus; 5-primary torsion in one other; 107-primary torsion in the third. Complete classifications of natural critical groups are useful precisely because they determine integral chip-firing dynamics beyond rational spectral data.
